Question B-001-001-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED) administers the Radiocommunication Act.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Transport Canada": Transport Canada has transportation responsibilities; ISED administers this Act.
- sourceIndex 2: "Communications Security Establishment Canada": Communications Security Establishment Canada (CSE) has security responsibilities; ISED administers amateur radio regulation.
- sourceIndex 3: "National Defence": National Defence is separate from the civilian spectrum-management role in amateur radio regulation.
